subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should successful embedded `after_compaction` hooks gain a durable current-session-only deferred `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` contract?
rationale: The implementation creates a new plugin-visible session lifecycle capability, so code correctness alone cannot determine whether this API should become a supported long-term contract.

options.title: Approve narrow hook API
options.body: Accept the capability only on successful embedded after-compaction contexts after queue ownership and live proof are corrected.

options.title: Keep reset core-owned
options.body: Remove the plugin API and place any post-compaction reset decision inside the owning core or compaction-plugin lifecycle.

recommendation.title: Approve narrow hook API
recommendation.body: Accept the capability only on successful embedded after-compaction contexts after queue ownership and live proof are corrected.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history most directly connects this person to the Gateway reset lifecycle and its cleanup boundary.
